history.administration_response: The Administration has implemented this recommendation: (a) In the fourth quarter of 2020, the Business Transformation and Accountability Division coordinated the clean-up activities related to misalignments between Umoja roles and delegation requirements inherited from before the creation of the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, the Department of Operational Support and the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs; (b) The Business Transformation and Accountability Division has implemented the quarterly monitoring of Umoja roles to identify those missing delegations. Entities are being advised to review such cases and either issue a new delegation or revoke Umoja roles that are no longer needed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has reviewed and cleaned up the misalignment between Umoja roles and delegation requirements, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
